row_policy.name: cosine_or_binary16_reference_floor_v1
row_policy.formula: cosine > 0.999 OR (row RMS error <= epsilon * original whole-stage RMS AND row peak error <= epsilon * original whole-stage peak)
row_policy.interpretation: Reference-scale engineering tolerance; not a network roundoff theorem.
